content.rendered:
Transforming Sherwood Middle School into an Elementary School

In summer 2018, our Transformation Visioning Advisory Committee met in a series of four meetings to begin exploring possibilities and ideas for the transition of our existing Sherwood Middle School location into an elementary school.  Please see links below for information and presentations from those meetings.

Transformation Visioning Advisory Committee

June 14, 2018

July 10, 2018

August 16, 2018

September 13, 2018

In September 2018, our Building Design Committee began meeting to discuss the guiding principles that would inform the design process for this transformation.  Please see links below for content from our Building Design Committee meetings.

September 26, 2018

October 9, 2018
